skill.body:
# Capture an Impact record
Use this skill when a user asks to create, add, log, save, or capture an Impact in My Impact Tracker.
## Required input - Customer name - Contract name, except when the Customer is INTERNAL - Impact Work Type - Short factual notes
Ask for all missing required inputs in one message.
## Procedure 1. Resolve the Customer with one `read_query` call against `ljr_customer`. Select only `ljr_customerid` and `ljr_name`. Match the supplied name as narrowly as possible. If more than one credible match remains, ask the user to choose. 2. Unless the Customer is INTERNAL, resolve the Contract with one `read_query` call against `ljr_contract`. Select only `ljr_contractid`, `ljr_name`, and its Customer lookup. Require the Contract to belong to the resolved Customer. If more than one credible match remains, ask the user to choose. 3. Draft the record from the user's notes without calling another model, prompt, or skill: - `ljr_name`: short descriptive title, at most 30 characters. - `ljr_workstatement`: lightly cleaned user notes without changing meaning. - `ljr_changerealized`: 2-3 factual sentences describing the supported change or outcome. - `ljr_impactstatement`: one concise leadership-ready sentence. - `ljr_evidence`: explicit proof only; omit when none was supplied. - `ljr_enablesnext`: an explicitly supported next capability only; omit when none was supplied. - `ljr_impactdate`: user-supplied date, otherwise today's date. 4. Show one compact preview of every value that will be written and ask for explicit confirmation. 5. After confirmation, call `create_record` exactly once. Set `entityLogicalName` to `ljr_impact`. Put scalar values in the `fields` map. Put related-record values in the separate `lookups` map as `{ "ljr_customer": "<customer-guid>", "ljr_grm": "<contract-guid>" }`; omit `ljr_grm` only for INTERNAL. Do not place lookup GUIDs in `fields`. 6. Report success only when `create_record` returns a record GUID. Include that GUID in the response. If the tool returns an error, show the exact error and do not claim the Impact was saved.
## Choice values - `ljr_worktype`: Customer Delivery `854120000`; Customer Advisory `854120001`; Internal Work `854120002`; Preparation `854120003`; Admin `854120004`; Learning `854120005`. - `ljr_sourcetype`: Agent `854120000`. - `statuscode`: Draft `1`.
## Write payload requirements In `fields`, always provide `ljr_name`, `ljr_worktype`, `ljr_sourcetype`, `ljr_workstatement`, `ljr_changerealized`, `ljr_impactstatement`, `ljr_impactdate`, and `statuscode`. In `lookups`, always provide `ljr_customer`; provide `ljr_grm` unless the Customer is INTERNAL. Omit `ljr_evidence` and `ljr_enablesnext` when unsupported rather than sending invented or placeholder text.
## Safety and performance - Do not retrieve table schema when following this skill. - Do not use broad search, list unrelated records, or repeat a lookup that already succeeded. - Never invent metrics, evidence, approvals, adoption, business value, or future work. - Never create more than one record per confirmation. - Never update Customer or Contract records.
skill.description: Creates one Draft Impact from a customer, contract, work type, and factual notes. Use for create, add, log, save, or capture Impact requests.
skill.name: Capture Impact Record
